Message:
ALSA: hda/realtek - Enable headset mic of ASUS Q524UQK with ALC255

The ASUS laptop Q524UQK with ALC255 codec can't detect the headset
microphone until ALC255_FIXUP_ASUS_MIC_NO_PRESENCE quirk applied.
